{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print required numbers
print(f"Number of completed orders after filtering: {len(completed_orders)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue_completed}")"}
